serverInfo.name: Apstal Analytics
serverInfo.description: AI-powered web analytics platform. Query site traffic, user behavior, session replays, conversion funnels, and ecommerce data via natural language or SQL.

capabilities.toolsDescription: Tools: login (sign in with email+password to get an API key), register (create account and optionally register a domain), server_info (server metadata and tool list), execute_sql (run read-only BigQuery SQL against analytics events with automatic project_id filtering), get_analytics (dashboard metrics: visitors, pageviews, bounce rate, top pages, sources, devices, countries, web vitals, conversions), list_projects (list tracked domains), register_domain (create a new project and get tracking snippet), get_schema (BigQuery events table schema), generate_api_key (create additional API keys).

authentication.instructions: Generate an API key in Settings, or use the login tool with email and password. Pass the key as: Authorization: Bearer apstal_yourkey
